1.consolidated_definition: "Manipulador": Persona que realiza movimientos precisos para manipular objetos o materiales en un proceso industrial o técnico.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Manipulator: Person who performs precise movements to manipulate objects or materials in an industrial or technical process.
